name: OpenVibe.Space

site.name: Space
site.what: Static site hosting moved here from OpenVibe.Host: immutable deploys, one-step rollback, previews, Git ingest and verified custom domains, at <name>.openvibe.website. Open to OpenVibe staff until the public launch; dynamic pages and spaces come next. The forum is on OpenVibe.Community.
site.description: OpenVibe.Space hosts static sites: every deploy is immutable and content-addressed, the active one rolls back in one step, previews are private to the project, a site can deploy from a public Git repository, and custom domains are served after a TXT check. Sites get a name under openvibe.website. Hosting is open to OpenVibe staff until the public launch, which waits for abuse handling and a designated DMCA agent. Dynamic pages and spaces (apps on your OpenVibe account) are next and not built yet. The former /s/* forum paths redirect permanently to openvibe.community.

pillars.title: Immutable deploys
pillars.text: Every deploy is kept, content-addressed, and the active one rolls back in one step.

pillars.title: Previews and Git
pillars.text: Private previews for the project, and deploys from a public Git repository.

pillars.title: Your own address
pillars.text: A name under openvibe.website, or a custom domain verified by a TXT record.

pillars.title: Staff first
pillars.text: Open to OpenVibe staff until abuse handling and a DMCA agent are in place.

site.keywords: openvibe space, code hosting, openvibe spaces, openvibe account, openvibe sdk
site.launch: Code hosting and spaces are still to be built; the forum moved back to OpenVibe.Community (2026-10-08).

liveness.means: the Space process answers HTTP; /api/ready checks PostgreSQL and reports degraded dependencies

drains: subscription retries stop; the HTTP server stops accepting requests and gives in-flight requests up to 4 seconds
the PostgreSQL pool closes and the process exits
shutdown.note: server/index.js uses openvibe-sdk/service gracefulStop with a 4-second drain and 5-second deadline

resumes.what: OpenVibe.Network's signing keys are fetched again at boot; sign-in lives in the browser's cookies, so nothing else resumes (Space consumes no events since the forum returned to Community)

conditions: automatic: ovhost deploy restores the prior sha if /api/ready fails in its readiness window
rollback.window: automatic during deploy readiness; manual afterwards while the previous code is database compatible

blockers.none: Space's own PostgreSQL migrations only create its tables, so an earlier release reads nothing it cannot handle

leases.none: no claims: one Space process runs and owns its database

notes: Space is OpenVibe's static site hosting since T20 step 2 (2026-10-12): the engine moved from OpenVibe.Host with its tables (Space migrations 0002-0005), under space.* capabilities and events. Tenant sites are served by Host header at <site>.openvibe.website and on TXT-verified custom domains; deploys are immutable and content-addressed with one-step rollback, previews, Git ingest from public repositories, per-site headers and redirects, takedowns and a resource index. SPACE_PUBLIC_HOSTING is off: only OpenVibe staff create projects, everyone else gets 403 space.not_launched. Consumes OpenVibe.Network (SSO, JWKS, client credentials) and OpenVibe.Media (objects, when the object store is media) and publishes through OpenVibe.Events (events.event.publish). The former forum paths /s/* redirect permanently to openvibe.community; the forum capabilities stay retired. The host.* hosting ids are retired once Host has dropped the engine.
